title: Pickled Onions
description: Vibrant pink pickled onions that look incredible and taste even better — a fridge staple that pairs with everything.
steps: Slice onion from root to stem into thin slices.
Add onion slices to a clean jar.
Combine water, vinegar and salt in a pot; bring to a boil.
Switch off heat; pour over onions.
Close jar; refrigerate. Ready in 1–2 hours.
notes: Add fresh ginger during simmering for extra flavour. Reuse the pickling liquid for a second batch of onions.
